title: Minimum distance from a hole to the part edge (sheet metal)
applies_to: flat sheet-metal or plate parts, holes through the thickness
measure: shortest distance from the hole's rim to the part's outer boundary

source.name: Fabcon, Sheet Metal Design for Manufacturability Guide (published 2026-03-02, checked 2026-10-27)
source.text: Keep at least 1.5-2x material thickness from any part edge.
source.note: 2.0 is the conservative end of that range. Protolabs gives fixed distances instead; see docs/sources.md.

why: a hole too close to the edge tears, bulges or distorts when the part is punched, cut or bent
